title: Quinoa and Zucchini Burgers
description: Vegetarian burgers of cooked quinoa, grated zucchini, eggs and breadcrumbs, chilled to firm up and then pan-fried.

steps.text: Pour 1.5 cups water into a pot, add the rinsed quinoa and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat and cook for 15 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and cool.
Add the coarsely grated, well-squeezed zucchini, breadcrumbs, eggs, salt and pepper and mix.

Heat a frying pan with a little oil, shape a small test patty and fry for about 1 minute on each side. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Cover the mixture with cling film and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Take the mixture out of the fridge about 15 minutes before cooking. Shape into 6 large flat burgers or 18 small ones.
Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat, add oil to a depth of 0.5 cm and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden.
For large burgers, cover the pan, reduce the heat and steam for about 5 minutes.
